_comment: Per-part assertions for validate.mjs. Bounds are generous sanity checks; tighten as the design settles. z/x/y are [min,max] inclusive ranges the part's bbox must fall WITHIN.

case_main.stl.desc: keyboard bowl with clean I/O window

block.stl.desc: swappable I/O block (panel+holder+reset), one watertight part

stand_bottom.stl.desc: tent stand base (frame + lock slots + hinge)

stand_top.stl.desc: tent stand cover (foot plate + hinge knuckles) — must tuck UNDER the case rim

stand_leg.stl.desc: deployed prop leg — FUNCTIONAL: foot tab must drop into the slot groove (z 2..5), not sit on top
